categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Modifies CI container scripts under ci/test/ and GitHub Actions cache configurations in .github/actions/.
categories.rationale: Prevents slow and potentially failing re-downloads of external BSD SDK archives when the CI base image cache misses. The description notes this avoids 'wasting time and risking job failure if those mirrors are unresponsive', providing a useful improvement to CI turnaround and reliability.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Although labeled Tests, the change modifies CI environment and container caching scripts rather than the test runner, test framework, harnesses, or test cases.
categories.rationale: Does not touch the test framework, test runners, or test harnesses; CI orchestration and container build scripts fall under Build and CI.
